Messages.Author: GymNat1
Messages.Body:
what if a vampire with no blood takes a point of damage, is prevented from
going to torpor via Undead Persistence, then subsequently takes aggravated
damage, does it burn?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Any wounded vampire who takes (and doesn't prevent) aggravated damage
will burn unless he pays a blood to prevent destruction, yes. [6.4.6]
